title: Ear Warmer
description: A cosy ribbed headband worked flat and seamed, perfect for cold morning walks.
expectationText: A quick accessory project that introduces back-loop-only ribbing for stretchy, textured fabric. Wear it the same day you start.

steps.title: Start the band
steps.instruction: Chain 14. This will be the width of the ear warmer, roughly 10 cm. Adjust chain count for a wider or narrower band.

steps.title: Row 1
steps.instruction: Half double crochet into the third chain from the hook and each chain across. Chain 2 and turn.

steps.title: Rows 2 to 12
steps.instruction: Half double crochet in the back loop only of each stitch across. Chain 2 and turn. This creates the ribbed texture.

steps.title: Continue ribbing
steps.instruction: Keep working back-loop-only half double crochet rows until the band wraps comfortably around your head, roughly 50 rows for an adult size.

steps.title: Seam the ends
steps.instruction: Lay the band flat without twisting. Bring the two short ends together and slip stitch or sew them to form a loop.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Fasten off and weave in the ends. Try it on and enjoy the warmth.
